module: Flowgraph node "Debug Text" (category repeat_instant, tags util/draw). Draws 3D text at a position (debugDrawer:drawTextAdvanced) every frame. Inputs: pos (vec3), text (any, converted by tostring), colorText (hidden, white by default), colorBG (hidden, semi-transparent black {0,0,0,0.75} by default).
notes: No test on pos: vec3(nil) is built if the pin is empty.
Colors are read with 4 components with no default value for alpha.

work.desc: Builds the colors (ColorF text, ColorI background *255) and draws the text.
